text: I answer the extension: no ADVANCE seat did. elder 10.0 [10, 7, 7, 7, 10] CORRECTION_REENTRY mp 75.0 STRONG is a fresh blue-to-green bar, the one thing in its favour. But ext_atr20 2.41 puts entry far over ma20, and Elder bids slightly under the average (C10). A completed hourly close over the swing high is the price in front of us. Clears: WATCH, or a pullback into ma20 with elder 7 or more.
